research.title: Missing-Data Baselines for Tabular Risk Prediction
bullets: Prepared tabular datasets by checking feature types, documenting missingness patterns, and fitting preprocessing transformations exclusively on training partitions.
Implemented assigned logistic regression and random forest baselines, comparing imputation strategies using held-out discrimination metrics and calibration plots.

work.title: Validation Utilities for Tabular Data Imports
bullets: Implemented Python validation routines for incoming tabular files, checking required columns, field types, and duplicate records before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and revised error messages to help maintainers identify and correct import failures.

projects.title: Regularized Regression for Residential Price Prediction
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression baselines with scikit-learn, combining numeric standardization and categorical encoding within training pipelines.
Selected regularization settings through cross-validation and examined held-out residuals to describe prediction errors across property characteristics.

projects.title: Naive Bayes Baselines for Document Classification
bullets: Constructed bag-of-words representations and implemented a multinomial naive Bayes baseline for classifying documents into predefined topic categories.
Compared count and term-frequency weighting using fixed data splits, then inspected confusion matrices and misclassified documents for recurring vocabulary ambiguities.
